title: An issue in Kibana allows Elasticsearch transforms in directly uploaded integration packages to run with Kibana's…
description: A vulnerability in Kibana allows Elasticsearch transforms within directly uploaded integration packages to execute with Kibana's internal system identity rather than the installing user's privileges. This flaw enables a user with Integrations: All and Agent policies: All privileges in a single Kibana space to access or modify data beyond their authorization, including agent policies from other spaces. The issue could lead to unauthorized data disclosure or command execution on managed Elastic Agent hosts.
